title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Free public concerts, galleries, library technology, cycling support, and outdoor activities at Illinois Wesleyan University and around Bloomington-Normal.

cards.title: Browse the Merwin Gallery
cards.subtitle: Free contemporary-art exhibitions at Illinois Wesleyan
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition schedule, then meet inside the Ames School of Art and Design for an unhurried gallery walk.
cards.short_summary: See rotating contemporary artwork in the larger of IWU’s two public galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Wesleyan states that all Merwin and Wakeley gallery exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during posted gallery hours; confirm the exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Explore the Wakeley Gallery
cards.subtitle: A smaller free exhibition space inside the Ames School
cards.notes: Pair up to examine the smaller-format exhibition closely, leaving time afterward to compare observations outside the gallery.
cards.short_summary: Use the intimate gallery setting for a focused art-looking session with a friend.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Wesleyan identifies Wakeley Gallery as one of its two gallery spaces and states that all exhibitions are free and public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during posted gallery hours; exhibitions rotate, so consult the gallery page first.

cards.title: Hear the Honor Orchestra
cards.subtitle: A free School of Music event in Bloomington
cards.notes: Bring a classmate to the scheduled performance and arrive early enough to settle in before the ensemble begins playing.
cards.short_summary: Share a live orchestral performance without buying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU lists Honor Orchestra among its 2026 annual music highlights and says all School of Music events are public and free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and free of charge; confirm the event time and venue with the Music Office because programs may change.

cards.title: Listen at Titan Choral Fest
cards.subtitle: Free choral programming from the IWU School of Music
cards.notes: Invite friends who enjoy vocal music, verify the calendar listing, and gather at the announced venue before the program starts.
cards.short_summary: Make a no-cost group outing around live choral music.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU lists Titan Choral Fest as a 2026 annual highlight and states that every School of Music event is open publicly and free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Public and free of charge; check the live calendar or contact the Music Office to confirm scheduling and location.

cards.title: Catch the Honor Band
cards.subtitle: A free ensemble event on the School of Music calendar
cards.notes: Choose a meeting point near Presser Hall, confirm the final venue, and enjoy the student musicians’ program together.
cards.short_summary: Turn a scheduled band performance into a free campus meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s music calendar lists Honor Band for 2026 and declares all School of Music events open to the public and free of charge.
cards.access_notes: No admission charge and public access; programs can change, so verify the performance details before going.

cards.title: Meet Up for Honor Jazz Band
cards.subtitle: Free jazz programming at Illinois Wesleyan
cards.notes: Check the School of Music calendar near the event date, then meet at the confirmed campus venue for the performance.
cards.short_summary: Hear young jazz musicians perform during a free public program.
cards.evidence_claim: IWU names Honor Jazz Band among its 2026 annual highlights and says all School of Music events are open to the public for free.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public with no charge; verify the current time and venue because the university notes that programs may change.

cards.title: Drop In on the Jazz Festival
cards.subtitle: Free daytime performances and clinics at Westbrook Auditorium
cards.notes: Use the published festival schedule to select a performance block at Westbrook Auditorium and coordinate arrival with friends.
cards.short_summary: Sample several jazz performances during IWU’s annual campus festival.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 2026 Jazz Festival program identifies Westbrook Auditorium as the venue and states that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: 51st Annual Illinois Wesleyan Jazz Festival Program
cards.access_notes: The campus festival program is free and public; use the current calendar for the next edition and exclude separately priced off-campus encores.

cards.title: Hold a Library Computer Session
cards.subtitle: No-charge computers at Bloomington Public Library
cards.notes: Bring a valid library card or eCard, claim neighboring computers if available, and work through a shared research task.
cards.short_summary: Use the library’s computers for a collaborative digital work session.
cards.evidence_claim: Bloomington Public Library says its Wi-Fi, desktop computers, and laptops may be used without charge; computers require a valid card or eCard.
cards.access_notes: Computer use requires a valid library card or eCard; building hours and available devices can vary.

cards.entity_name: Hansen Student Center Bike Repair Station
cards.title: Tune Up Bikes at Hansen
cards.subtitle: A free repair station on the IWU campus
cards.notes: Bring a bicycle needing a small adjustment and use the station’s basic tools together before taking a short test ride.
cards.short_summary: Handle basic bicycle maintenance with the free tools outside Hansen Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Normal lists a free bicycle-repair station at Illinois Wesleyan’s Hansen Student Center, 300 E. Beecher Street.
cards.access_notes: The station supplies basic tools and is free to use; bring any replacement parts your bicycle requires.

cards.title: Walk Through Refuge Food Forest
cards.subtitle: Free public produce at One Normal Plaza
cards.notes: Visit with a friend, identify what is ready to harvest, and pick only usable produce while leaving enough for others.
cards.short_summary: Combine an outdoor walk with responsible harvesting from a public food forest.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Normal states that Refuge Food Forest is open to the public and that its produce is free to pick.
cards.access_notes: Public access and produce picking are free; harvest only available produce and observe posted site guidance.

warnings: The School of Music states that programs are subject to change; confirm dates, times, and venues before attending.
The 2026 Jazz Festival has concluded as of the fetch date; consult the official calendar for the next annual edition.
Coordinates were left null because exact point coordinates were not established by the cited direct sources.
